```{r 1. setup, include=FALSE}
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
set.seed(42)
RNGkind(kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
options(contrasts = c("contr.treatment", "contr.poly"))

# Function to install packages if missing
install_if_missing <- function(packages) {
  new_packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
  if(length(new_packages)) {
    install.packages(new_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
}

# List of required packages
packages <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "lubridate", "forecast", "ranger", "e1071", "slider", "ggplot2", "yardstick", "kableExtra")

# Install if missing (fully suppress output)
invisible(suppressPackageStartupMessages(
  suppressWarnings(
    suppressMessages(install_if_missing(packages))
  )
))

# Load packages (fully suppress output)
invisible(suppressWarnings(
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(tidyverse)
    library(readxl)
    library(lubridate)
    library(forecast)
    library(ranger)
    library(e1071)
    library(slider)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(yardstick)
    library(kableExtra)
  })
))

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.6)
```

# Matcha Haven Revenue Forecasting & Regression Analysis

```{r 2. helpers for reproducibility}
assert_cols <- function(df, cols, name = "data frame") {
  miss <- setdiff(cols, names(df))
  if (length(miss)) stop(sprintf("missing columns in %s: %s", name, paste(miss, collapse = ", ")))
}

ordered_dow <- function(d) {
  lv <- c("Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday")
  factor(d, levels = lv, ordered = TRUE)
}

rmse <- function(a, p) sqrt(mean((a - p)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae  <- function(a, p) mean(abs(a - p), na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r 3. Load integrated dataset}
sales_path <- "C:/Users/OMAR/Downloads/MatchaHaven1.xlsx"

sales_raw <- read_excel(sales_path, sheet = "Sales") %>% 
  mutate(Datetime = as_datetime(Datetime, tz = "UTC"))

inv_raw <- read_excel(sales_path, sheet = "Inventory")

assert_cols(sales_raw, c("Datetime","ItemName","Category","Qty","TotalAmount"), "Sales")
assert_cols(inv_raw,   c("Date","Item","Category","OpeningStock","Purchases","Sales","Waste","ClosingStock","ReorderFlag","ReorderPoint","TargetStock","AvgDailySales"), "Inventory")

date_range_sales <- range(as_date(sales_raw$Datetime))
date_range_inv   <- range(as_date(inv_raw$Date))
list(sales_span = date_range_sales, inv_span = date_range_inv)
```

```{r 4. daily revenue preparation}
daily_rev <- sales_raw %>%
  mutate(Date = as_date(Datetime)) %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(Revenue = sum(TotalAmount, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(DayOfWeek = ordered_dow(weekdays(Date)))

stopifnot(nrow(daily_rev) >= 60)

# Daily summaries
daily_summary <- daily_rev %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Daily = mean(Revenue),
    Min_Daily = min(Revenue),
    Max_Daily = max(Revenue),
    SD_Daily = sd(Revenue)
  )

# Weekly aggregation and summaries
weekly_rev <- daily_rev %>%
  mutate(Week = floor_date(Date, "week")) %>%
  group_by(Week) %>%
  summarise(Revenue = sum(Revenue), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Week)

weekly_summary <- weekly_rev %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Weekly = mean(Revenue),
    Min_Weekly = min(Revenue),
    Max_Weekly = max(Revenue),
    SD_Weekly = sd(Revenue)
  )
daily_summary
weekly_summary
```

```{r 5. integrity check inventory vs sales}
sales_item_daily <- sales_raw %>%
  mutate(Date = as_date(Datetime)) %>%
  group_by(Date, Item = ItemName, Category) %>%
  summarise(Sales_Qty = sum(Qty, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

inv_chk <- inv_raw %>%
  mutate(Date = as_date(Date)) %>%
  group_by(Date, Item, Category) %>%
  summarise(Inv_Sales = sum(Sales, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  full_join(sales_item_daily, by = c("Date","Item","Category")) %>%
  mutate(
    Sales_Qty = replace_na(Sales_Qty, 0),
    Inv_Sales = replace_na(Inv_Sales, 0),
    Diff = Inv_Sales - Sales_Qty
  )

integrity_summary <- inv_chk %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    perfect_matches = sum(Diff == 0),
    pct_match = mean(Diff == 0) * 100,
    max_abs_diff = max(abs(Diff), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
integrity_summary
```

```{r 6. full historical data as train (no split) }
# Full data as train (ends ~2025-09-30)
train <- daily_rev  # Full historical
h <- 84  # 12 weeks ahead (Oct 1 - Dec 23, 2025)

end_date <- max(train$Date)
future_dates <- seq(end_date + 1, by = "day", length.out = h)

list(
  train_start = min(train$Date), 
  train_end = end_date,
  forecast_start = min(future_dates), 
  forecast_end = max(future_dates),
  h = h
)
```

```{r 7. arima plus ets baseline}
# Time series (weekly frequency, proper start)
train_start_date <- min(train$Date)
train_start_year <- year(train_start_date)
train_start_doy <- yday(train_start_date)
y_train_ts <- ts(train$Revenue, start = c(train_start_year, train_start_doy), frequency = 7)

set.seed(42)
fit_arima <- auto.arima(y_train_ts, seasonal = TRUE, stepwise = TRUE, approximation = FALSE)
fit_ets   <- ets(y_train_ts)

fc_arima <- forecast(fit_arima, h = h)
fc_ets   <- forecast(fit_ets,   h = h)

base_fc <- as.numeric((fc_arima$mean + fc_ets$mean) / 2)

# Daily forecast DF
base_fc_df <- data.frame(
  Date = future_dates,
  Forecast = base_fc,
  Lower_80 = (fc_arima$lower[,1] + fc_ets$lower[,1]) / 2,
  Upper_80 = (fc_arima$upper[,1] + fc_ets$upper[,1]) / 2
) %>%
  mutate(
    Month = month(Date, label = TRUE),
    Week = week(Date),
    DayOfWeek = ordered_dow(weekdays(Date))
  )

# Daily summaries for forecast
daily_fc_summary <- base_fc_df %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Daily_Fc = mean(Forecast),
    Min_Daily_Fc = min(Forecast),
    Max_Daily_Fc = max(Forecast),
    SD_Daily_Fc = sd(Forecast)
  )

# Weekly forecast aggregation
weekly_fc <- base_fc_df %>%
  mutate(Week = floor_date(Date, "week")) %>%
  group_by(Week) %>%
  summarise(Weekly_Forecast = sum(Forecast), .groups = "drop")

weekly_fc_summary <- weekly_fc %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Weekly_Fc = mean(Weekly_Forecast),
    Min_Weekly_Fc = min(Weekly_Forecast),
    Max_Weekly_Fc = max(Weekly_Forecast),
    SD_Weekly_Fc = sd(Weekly_Forecast)
  )

# Monthly totals
monthly_totals <- base_fc_df %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(Total_Forecast = sum(Forecast), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Month_Num = match(Month, month.abb))  # For ordering if needed

daily_fc_summary
weekly_fc_summary
monthly_totals
base_fc_df
```

```{r 8. plot baseline}
# Combine historical and forecast for plotting
hist_plot_df <- train %>%
  select(Date, Revenue) %>%
  mutate(Series = "Historical")

fc_plot_df <- base_fc_df %>%
  select(Date, Forecast) %>%
  rename(Revenue = Forecast) %>%
  mutate(Series = "Baseline Forecast")

plot_df <- bind_rows(hist_plot_df, fc_plot_df) %>%
  mutate(Series = factor(Series, levels = c("Historical", "Baseline Forecast")))

ggplot(plot_df, aes(Date, Revenue, color = Series)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(data = base_fc_df, aes(x = Date, ymin = Lower_80, ymax = Upper_80), 
              inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.2, fill = "red") +
  labs(title = "ARIMA + ETS Baseline: Historical + 12-Week Forecast (Oct-Dec 2025)", 
       x = "Date", y = "Revenue (KES)", color = "Series") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r 9. model matrices for calendar features (full + future}
# Historical train features
X_train <- model.matrix(Revenue ~ DayOfWeek, data = train)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
y_train <- train$Revenue

# Future features (only DayOfWeek, as lags later)
future_feats <- data.frame(DayOfWeek = base_fc_df$DayOfWeek)
X_future  <- model.matrix(~ DayOfWeek, data = future_feats)[, -1, drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(X_train), colnames(X_future)))
```

```{r 10. random forest forecast}
set.seed(42)
rf <- ranger(
  formula = Revenue ~ .,
  data = data.frame(Revenue = y_train, X_train),
  num.trees = 300,
  mtry = max(1, floor(ncol(X_train) / 2)),
  min.node.size = 3,
  importance = "impurity",
  seed = 42,
  keep.inbag = TRUE
)

pred_rf_fc <- predict(rf, data.frame(X_future), seed = 42)$predictions

rf_fc_df <- data.frame(
  Date = future_dates,
  Forecast = as.numeric(pred_rf_fc)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Month = month(Date, label = TRUE),
    Week = week(Date)
  )

# Daily/Weekly summaries for RF
daily_rf_summary <- rf_fc_df %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Daily_RF = mean(Forecast),
    Min_Daily_RF = min(Forecast),
    Max_Daily_RF = max(Forecast),
    SD_Daily_RF = sd(Forecast)
  )

weekly_rf <- rf_fc_df %>%
  mutate(Week = floor_date(Date, "week")) %>%
  group_by(Week) %>%
  summarise(Weekly_Forecast = sum(Forecast), .groups = "drop")

weekly_rf_summary <- weekly_rf %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Weekly_RF = mean(Weekly_Forecast),
    Min_Weekly_RF = min(Weekly_Forecast),
    Max_Weekly_RF = max(Weekly_Forecast),
    SD_Weekly_RF = sd(Weekly_Forecast)
  )

monthly_rf_totals <- rf_fc_df %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(Total_Forecast = sum(Forecast), .groups = "drop")

daily_rf_summary
weekly_rf_summary
monthly_rf_totals
rf_fc_df
```

```{r 11. support vector regression forecast}
set.seed(42)
svr <- svm(
  x = X_train, y = y_train,
  kernel = "radial",
  cost = 10,
  epsilon = 0.1,
  scale = TRUE,
  type = "eps-regression"
)

pred_svr_fc <- predict(svr, X_future)

svr_fc_df <- data.frame(
  Date = future_dates,
  Forecast = as.numeric(pred_svr_fc)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Month = month(Date, label = TRUE),
    Week = week(Date)
  )

# Daily/Weekly summaries for SVR
daily_svr_summary <- svr_fc_df %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Daily_SVR = mean(Forecast),
    Min_Daily_SVR = min(Forecast),
    Max_Daily_SVR = max(Forecast),
    SD_Daily_SVR = sd(Forecast)
  )

weekly_svr <- svr_fc_df %>%
  mutate(Week = floor_date(Date, "week")) %>%
  group_by(Week) %>%
  summarise(Weekly_Forecast = sum(Forecast), .groups = "drop")

weekly_svr_summary <- weekly_svr %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Weekly_SVR = mean(Weekly_Forecast),
    Min_Weekly_SVR = min(Weekly_Forecast),
    Max_Weekly_SVR = max(Weekly_Forecast),
    SD_Weekly_SVR = sd(Weekly_Forecast)
  )

monthly_svr_totals <- svr_fc_df %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(Total_Forecast = sum(Forecast), .groups = "drop")

daily_svr_summary
weekly_svr_summary
monthly_svr_totals
svr_fc_df
```

```{r 13. residual corrected hybrid setup and forecast}
# In-sample ensemble fits for residuals
fit_arima_in <- as.numeric(fitted(fit_arima))
fit_ets_in   <- as.numeric(fitted(fit_ets))
k <- min(length(fit_arima_in), length(fit_ets_in), nrow(train))
ens_in <- (fit_arima_in[seq_len(k)] + fit_ets_in[seq_len(k)]) / 2
train_k <- tail(train, k)
resid_train <- train_k$Revenue - ens_in

# Extend full series with base_fc for autoregressive features
full_hist <- bind_rows(train, tibble(Date = future_dates, Revenue = base_fc)) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(
    DayOfWeek = ordered_dow(weekdays(Date)),
    rev_lag1 = lag(Revenue, 1),
    rev_lag7 = lag(Revenue, 7),
    ma7  = slide_dbl(Revenue, mean, .before = 6,  .complete = TRUE),
    ma14 = slide_dbl(Revenue, mean, .before = 13, .complete = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  left_join(train_k %>% transmute(Date, resid_train), by = "Date")

feat_cols <- c("DayOfWeek","rev_lag1","rev_lag7","ma7","ma14")
train_rows <- which(!is.na(full_hist$resid_train))
train_res_df <- full_hist[train_rows, c("Date","resid_train", feat_cols)]
names(train_res_df)[2] <- "Residual"

# Future features from extended series
future_res_feats <- tail(full_hist, h)[, feat_cols]

dummies <- function(df) {
  dd <- model.matrix(~ DayOfWeek, df)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  cbind(df %>% select(-DayOfWeek), as.data.frame(dd))
}

Xr_train <- as.matrix(dummies(train_res_df[, feat_cols]))
yr_train <- train_res_df$Residual
Xr_future <- as.matrix(dummies(future_res_feats))

# Align columns (now on matrices, so handle manually)
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(Xr_train), colnames(Xr_future))
Xr_train <- Xr_train[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
Xr_future <- Xr_future[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]

# If missing in future, add zero columns
miss <- setdiff(colnames(Xr_train), colnames(Xr_future))
if (length(miss) > 0) {
  Xr_future <- cbind(Xr_future, matrix(0, nrow = nrow(Xr_future), ncol = length(miss), 
                                       dimnames = list(NULL, miss)))
  Xr_future <- Xr_future[, colnames(Xr_train), drop = FALSE]
}
```

```{r 14. residual models and hybrid forecasts}
set.seed(42)
rf_resid <- ranger(x = Xr_train, y = yr_train,
                   num.trees = 400, mtry = max(1, floor(ncol(Xr_train) / 2)),
                   min.node.size = 3, seed = 42, keep.inbag = TRUE)

svr_resid <- svm(x = Xr_train, y = yr_train,
                 kernel = "radial", cost = 10, epsilon = 0.1, scale = TRUE,
                 type = "eps-regression")

pred_rf_res_fc  <- predict(rf_resid, data = Xr_future)$predictions
pred_svr_res_fc <- predict(svr_resid, Xr_future)

hyb_rf_fc  <- base_fc + pred_rf_res_fc
hyb_svr_fc <- base_fc + pred_svr_res_fc

# Hybrid DFs
hyb_rf_df <- data.frame(
  Date = future_dates,
  Forecast = hyb_rf_fc
) %>%
  mutate(Month = month(Date, label = TRUE), Week = week(Date))

hyb_svr_df <- data.frame(
  Date = future_dates,
  Forecast = hyb_svr_fc
) %>%
  mutate(Month = month(Date, label = TRUE), Week = week(Date))

# Summaries for hybrids (daily/weekly/monthly)
daily_hyb_rf_summary <- hyb_rf_df %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Daily_HybRF = mean(Forecast),
    Min_Daily_HybRF = min(Forecast),
    Max_Daily_HybRF = max(Forecast),
    SD_Daily_HybRF = sd(Forecast)
  )

weekly_hyb_rf <- hyb_rf_df %>%
  mutate(Week = floor_date(Date, "week")) %>%
  group_by(Week) %>%
  summarise(Weekly_Forecast = sum(Forecast), .groups = "drop")
weekly_hyb_rf_summary <- weekly_hyb_rf %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Weekly_HybRF = mean(Weekly_Forecast),
    Min_Weekly_HybRF = min(Weekly_Forecast),
    Max_Weekly_HybRF = max(Weekly_Forecast),
    SD_Weekly_HybRF = sd(Weekly_Forecast)
  )

monthly_hyb_rf_totals <- hyb_rf_df %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(Total_Forecast = sum(Forecast), .groups = "drop")

# Similar for SVR hybrid (omitted for brevity; repeat pattern)
daily_hyb_svr_summary <- hyb_svr_df %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Daily_HybSVR = mean(Forecast),
    Min_Daily_HybSVR = min(Forecast),
    Max_Daily_HybSVR = max(Forecast),
    SD_Daily_HybSVR = sd(Forecast)
  )

weekly_hyb_svr <- hyb_svr_df %>%
  mutate(Week = floor_date(Date, "week")) %>%
  group_by(Week) %>%
  summarise(Weekly_Forecast = sum(Forecast), .groups = "drop")
weekly_hyb_svr_summary <- weekly_hyb_svr %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Weekly_HybSVR = mean(Weekly_Forecast),
    Min_Weekly_HybSVR = min(Weekly_Forecast),
    Max_Weekly_HybSVR = max(Weekly_Forecast),
    SD_Weekly_HybSVR = sd(Weekly_Forecast)
  )

monthly_hyb_svr_totals <- hyb_svr_df %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(Total_Forecast = sum(Forecast), .groups = "drop")

daily_hyb_rf_summary 
weekly_hyb_rf_summary
monthly_hyb_rf_totals
daily_hyb_svr_summary
weekly_hyb_svr_summary
monthly_hyb_svr_totals
hyb_rf_df  
hyb_svr_df
```

```{r 16. inventory kpis and visuals (with weekly)}
inv <- inv_raw %>%
  mutate(Date = as_date(Date),
         DaysOfCover = if_else(AvgDailySales > 0, ClosingStock / AvgDailySales, NA_real_))

# Daily KPIs
inv_kpis_daily <- list(
  stockout_rate_daily = mean(inv$ClosingStock <= 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
  reorder_rate_daily  = mean(inv$ReorderFlag == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
  avg_days_cover_daily = mean(inv$DaysOfCover, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Weekly aggregation for KPIs
weekly_inv <- inv %>%
  mutate(Week = floor_date(Date, "week")) %>%
  group_by(Week, Item, Category) %>%
  summarise(
    ClosingStock_Weekly = mean(ClosingStock),
    AvgDailySales_Weekly = mean(AvgDailySales),
    ReorderFlag_Weekly = mean(ReorderFlag == 1) * 100,
    DaysOfCover_Weekly = mean(DaysOfCover, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

inv_kpis_weekly <- list(
  stockout_rate_weekly = mean(weekly_inv$ClosingStock_Weekly <= 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
  reorder_rate_weekly  = mean(weekly_inv$ReorderFlag_Weekly, na.rm = TRUE),
  avg_days_cover_weekly = mean(weekly_inv$DaysOfCover_Weekly, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Pretty tibble summary
kpi_summary <- tibble(
  Period = c("Daily", "Weekly"),
  Stockout_Rate = c(inv_kpis_daily$stockout_rate_daily, inv_kpis_weekly$stockout_rate_weekly),
  Reorder_Rate = c(inv_kpis_daily$reorder_rate_daily, inv_kpis_weekly$reorder_rate_weekly),
  Avg_Days_Cover = c(inv_kpis_daily$avg_days_cover_daily, inv_kpis_weekly$avg_days_cover_weekly)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Stockout_Rate = round(Stockout_Rate, 1),
    Reorder_Rate = round(Reorder_Rate, 1),
    Avg_Days_Cover = round(Avg_Days_Cover, 1)
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable(
    col.names = c("Period", "Stockout Rate (%)", "Reorder Rate (%)", "Avg. Days of Cover"),
    caption = "Inventory KPIs: Daily vs. Weekly Averages",
    align = "lccc",
    digits = 1
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

kpi_summary
```

```{r 19. model performance on validation (RMSE, MAE, MAPE)}
# Metrics from holdout validation (last ~20% historical as actuals)
mape <- function(a, p) mean(abs((a - p) / a) * 100, na.rm = TRUE)

models <- c("ARIMA/ETS Ensemble", "RF", "SVR", "Hybrid RF", "Hybrid SVR")
preds <- list(base_fc_val, pred_rf_val, pred_svr_val, hyb_rf_val, hyb_svr_val)
actual <- y_val

metrics_df <- map_dfr(seq_along(models), ~ {
  pred <- preds[[.x]]
  tibble(
    Model = models[.x],
    RMSE = round(rmse(actual, pred), 2),
    MAE = round(mae(actual, pred), 2),
    MAPE = round(mape(actual, pred), 2)
  )
})

# Identify best model (lowest RMSE)
best_model <- metrics_df[which.min(metrics_df$RMSE), "Model"]

# Pretty table with best highlighted
library(kableExtra)
metrics_table <- metrics_df %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Model", "RMSE (KES)", "MAE (KES)", "MAPE (%)"),
    caption = "Model Performance on Validation Set",
    digits = c(0, 0, 0, 1),
    align = "lccc"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(which(metrics_df$Model == best_model), bold = TRUE, background = "lightgreen") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  footnote(paste("Best model (lowest RMSE):", best_model))

metrics_table
```

```{r 20. 12-week forecast evaluation}
# Bind all forecasts for comparison
all_forecasts <- bind_rows(
  base_fc_df %>% mutate(Model = "ARIMA/ETS Ensemble", Value = Forecast),
  rf_fc_df %>% mutate(Model = "RF", Value = Forecast),
  svr_fc_df %>% mutate(Model = "SVR", Value = Forecast),
  hyb_rf_df %>% mutate(Model = "Hybrid RF", Value = Forecast),
  hyb_svr_df %>% mutate(Model = "Hybrid SVR", Value = Forecast)
) %>%
  select(Model, Date, Value)

# Overall summaries
fc_summary <- all_forecasts %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Forecast = round(sum(Value), 0),
    Mean_Daily = round(mean(Value), 0),
    SD_Daily = round(sd(Value), 0),
    CV_Percent = round((SD_Daily / Mean_Daily) * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Forecast))

# Monthly totals per model
monthly_fc <- all_forecasts %>%
  mutate(Month = month(Date, label = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(Model, Month) %>%
  summarise(Total_Monthly = round(sum(Value), 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Month, values_from = Total_Monthly, values_fill = 0)

# Cross-model correlations (on daily values)
cor_matrix <- all_forecasts %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = Value) %>%
  select(-Date) %>%
  cor(use = "complete.obs") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Model") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Model, names_to = "Compared_To", values_to = "Correlation") %>%
  filter(Model < Compared_To) %>%  # Upper triangle only
  mutate(Correlation = round(Correlation, 3))

# Pretty tables
library(kableExtra)

summary_table <- fc_summary %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Model", "Total (KES)", "Mean Daily (KES)", "SD Daily (KES)", "CV (%)"),
    caption = "12-Week Forecast Summary (Oct–Dec 2025)",
    digits = 0,
    align = "lcccc"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

monthly_table <- monthly_fc %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Model", "October", "November", "December"),
    caption = "Monthly Forecast Totals by Model (KES)",
    digits = 0,
    align = "lccc"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

cor_table <- cor_matrix %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Model", "Compared To", "Correlation"),
    caption = "Cross-Model Forecast Consistency (Daily Values)",
    digits = 3,
    align = "lcc"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

# Output tables
summary_table
monthly_table
cor_table

# Interpretation note (as comment; remove if undesired)
cat("Key Insights:\n- Higher totals suggest optimistic models (e.g., hybrids may capture trends better).\n- Low CV (<20%) indicates stable predictions; high (>50%) flags volatility (e.g., weekend spikes).\n- Correlations >0.8 mean models agree—trust ensembles more.\n")
```

```{r 21. RF Model Deep Dive}
  labs(title = "RF Model: Historical Revenue + 12-Week Forecast (Oct-Dec 2025)",
       x = "Date", y = "Revenue (KES)", color = "Series") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Historical" = "blue", "RF Forecast" = "red"))
```
